name: Talamanca Range-La Amistad Reserves / La Amistad National Park
description: This vast protected wilderness straddles the Costa Rica–Panama border in the Talamanca mountains, and the two countries manage it together. Tropical rainforest blankets most of the slopes, and ancient glaciers once carved the highest ground. Because it sits where North and South America meet, species from both continents mingle here. Four Indigenous peoples still live within its bounds.
